Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2774, which you can use as ❴ in HTML, \2774 in CSS, or type with Alt+10100 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2774 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ❴ or the hex escape ❴.

How to type medium left curly bracket ornament on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 0 1 0 0 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 10100.
  4. Release Alt. The Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament character (❴) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type medium left curly bracket ornament on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament" and click the character to insert it.

How to use medium left curly bracket ornament in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2774"; ()
  • Python: \u2774 or chr(0x2774)
  • JavaScript: \u2774 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2774)
  • JSON: "\u2774"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ❴?

No legacy Alt code exists for Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2774 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ❴ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ❴, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+10100 not work?

Alt+10100 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament?

The Unicode codepoint for Medium Left Curly Bracket Ornament is U+2774. You can use this value in HTML as ❴, in CSS as \2774, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ❴ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2774, then click it.
